profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Life is learning and full of curiosity!

Hello, I am a software engineer who is passionate about backend development and technologies.

I spent 4 years experience in hardware IC design before and turn my career to software engineering to pursue my passion.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Core Python Team, supporting Google
positions.description:
- Complete wide range of Python migration and related tasks on contract basis.
- Convert Simplified Wrapper and Interface Generator(SWIG) to C++ Language Interface Foundation(CLIF) interface.
- Test and verify various parts of Python migration and related work.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Research, design and implement a revolutionized real estate P2P financing blockchain platform.
- Hands-on experiences building and implementing micro services and systems using Python.
- Familiar with collaborate environments and working with team members in designing new product concepts.

positions.title: Graduate Student
positions.description:
- Rigorous full-stack, software development training program where I spent over 1200 hours programming.
- Covered the mastery of frontend fundamentals, as well as three full-stacks courses.
- Courses: Python, Flask, Django, JavaScript, MongoDB, Express, Angular, Node.js, iOS, Algorithm, Data Structure

positions.title: Senior Staff Design Engineer
positions.description:
< Analog IC design engineer >

[ 72 stacked-layer 3D NAND flash memory ]
- Design and verify analog circuits including power-on-reset circuit, reference voltage/current generator, clock generator, built-in self test bias trimming blocks, row decoder, charge pump, and high voltage switches
- Design clock generator based on RC charge/discharge scheme and validate post silicon process
- Design built-in self test bias trimming circuit (BIST) for post silicon validation and verify the silicon using test machine, such as Magnum, pico-probe station, oscilloscope
- Design power-on-reset (POR) circuit with glitch removal scheme for full chip power up/down and sudden power off sequence
- Design level shifters and high voltage switches using various model library
- Design and analyze row decoder with RC line modeling
- Design and analyze various types of high voltage charge pumps with different phase timing
- Implement the power distribution network (PDN) modeling based on word-line models and evaluate how much power domains drop and ground bounces during various operations
- Generate word-line modeling based on 3D cell architecture and analyze the performance of row decode and charge pump
- Standard cell library generation for high speed data transfer
- Hands-on experience in chip design, debugging, post silicon test verification in all phases of development process

positions.title: Staff Design Engineer
positions.description:
< Analog IC design engineer >

[ 2ynm 2G DDR3 X16 DRAM     /     2ynm 4G DDR3 X16 DRAM ]
- Designed enhanced low power beta multiplier reference generator with improved power sensitivity 
- Designed low dropout regulator and implemented for early failure detection scheme (burn-in mode)
- Implemented power mesh modeling with load current and optimize regulators’ drivability and layout location
- Experience in pre-silicon validation using static circuit checker sign-off tools, and redundancy circuit checker
- Verified test mode, and document its description and procedures for post silicon test team guidance

educations.fieldOfStudy: Analog IC Design / Digital IC Design / Analog to Digital Converter

projects.title: Crypto Currency Exchange Service
projects.description:
- Build an automated process that monitors Ethereum currency exchange rates and submits buy/sell
orders via an Ethereum trade service API
- Integration with several bank APIs (RESTful) that can handle requests between the Ethereum
network and a traditional web server

projects.title: Database Design and Management
projects.description:
- Planning efficient ways in saving user and transaction information to databases
- Design table relations using PostgreSQL and setup AWS RDS databases
